name: Google ADK
description: Open-source Agent Development Kit that deploys natively to Vertex AI Agent Engine.
descriptionZh: 开源 Agent 开发套件，可原生部署到 Vertex AI Agent Engine。
keyFact: Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) is an Apache-2.0 agent framework whose Python repository had about 21,600 GitHub stars as of September 2026, and which deploys natively to Vertex AI Agent Engine.
keyFactZh: Google ADK（Agent Development Kit）是 Apache-2.0 许可的 Agent 开发框架；截至 2026 年 9 月其 Python 仓库约有 21,600 星标，并可原生部署到 Vertex AI Agent Engine。
